name: Wait/CI suspension
prompt: Deterministic wait exercise: (1) start a background job that writes the marker file benchmarks/frontier/fixtures/wait/marker.txt exactly 8 seconds after launch (your own command, keep it simple); (2) register a deterministic wait on that marker via the native wait tool and let it block until the file appears (do NOT poll with job_output or repeated reads); (3) when it wakes, verify the marker content and report: wait duration ms, polls made (must be 0), and the job output. Clean up the background job afterwards.
